title: repro setup keeps an earlier run's results.jsonl and run.json, so run skips areas and record and compare read old shas
goal: repro setup over a DIR that holds results.jsonl or run.json from an earlier setup refuses, naming them, so a run after a re-setup starts every area and record and compare read only the new instances' shas; repro setup installs the kb's hooks in each instance clone (kbgit.py install-hooks), as repro check does in its probe

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import inspect,bench_repro as b;s=inspect.getsource(b.setup);sys.exit(0 if ('RESULTS' in s or 'results.jsonl' in s) else 1)

repro_reason: setup makes real clones and bare copies of the checkout; the defect is that setup never names the results files

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import inspect,bench_repro as b;s=inspect.getsource(b.setup);sys.exit(0 if 'install-hooks' in s else 1)

notes: Plan 2026-10-15: merges BG-2iihhs43 (repro setup does not install hooks in run instances; every sync of the first run printed commit hooks not installed, lessons analysis 1.6), whose repro is the first check; this bug's own repro reads setup's source for RESULTS. Checks that pass before the work: the test selection pass before the work and are kept as guards (the change must keep them green); check 0 and the repro fails before the work and reads the goal. Each guard check named above as passing on the base passes before the work: it pins behaviour that must stay green (a test selection the work extends, the eval, the lint); the item's failing checks read its goal.
